actions.visualLabel: The controlled Java4Shell demonstration and published design do not establish broad production reliability; security teams retain deployment approval.
System counts are quarter-end stocks and cannot be divided into a commissioning rate; unit economics and installation-level intervention remain unavailable.

The 113 figure is the confirmed rollout list, not evidence of active pools, depth, weekend volume, fee income or redemption performance.
The studies differ in age groups, settings, tutor design and outcome measures; the reader exercise can collect examples but cannot produce causal evidence without a randomized protocol.
The customer is unnamed, financing terms are incomplete, and H1 2028 delivery remains subject to development, utility and regulatory milestones.
The announcement omits preference terms, use of proceeds, cash burn, durable-resolution economics and any allocation available to Robin.
The 23.98 percentage-point relative move is consistent with a leadership-risk repricing but does not establish causation or change orders, delivery or margin guidance.
